posts.body:
theres a number of issues with the snippets that youve provided.
Pearlie said:
actor.equipItem.actorX(1, $dataWeapons[$gameVariables.value(21)])
Click to expand...
if you put "actor" in the scriptbox, youll immediately get an error as that wont be defined. thats why i said "once you have a reference to the actor". you already stored the actor's id into a variable, so $gameActors.actor([$gameVariables.value(21)) would be your reference
equipItem is a function and is the function youre supposed to use.
equipItems doesnt return anything. its call wouldnt have any properties. what is actorX supposed to be?
i told you about the arguments equipItem takes, but i assumed the value of the variable an id for the weapon. Even though you didnt call it, what you did try to call would use the weapon that shares the id as the actor whose id you stored in the variable. if that isnt the case, you need to use another variable or place an id in manually
Pearlie said:
actor.addSpell.actorX($dataSpells[$gameVariables.value(22)]
Click to expand...

$dataSpells isnt a thing within RPGMaker MV
